text: Beli is a Celtic ancestral figure, and he is many also a god. His full title is Beli Mawr, or Beli Mawr fab Tacitus. He is a father in the Welsh family line and may descend from the god Bel onal Berea. In the Mabinogion he is the consort of the mother goddess Do the goddess Arianrhod and the warrior Casaccia. In the tale of Maxin, Beli rules Britain until the hero arrives with his armies and pushes him into the sea. Writers have cast him as a god of death and of the sea. The ocean is sometimes called 'Blook li' or the liquor of the sun. The London place named Billingsgate appears to hold his name. Some writers link him to a little-known Irish god called Bile.

okr.objective: Beli is a Welsh ancestral father tied to gods, royalty, and the event of the sea.
